title: UI: Library panel item types and icons
description: Enhance the authoring-ui Library panel to show type-specific icons and info for each item type: Symbol (movieclip/button/graphic icon), BitmapItem (image thumbnail or icon), SoundItem (audio icon + duration), FontItem (Aa icon). Currently the Library panel shows all items the same. The panel code is in packages/authoring-ui/src/. Add CSS classes per item type, use unicode icons or SVG. Does NOT touch Shell.tsx — only LibraryPanel.tsx (or equivalent).
